speaker: announcer
text: Special bulletin. The fog is in Thorne's lab. Five pages are gray. You are very small.

speaker: announcer
text: You are Sphere Nineteen. The subject that answered. The others are taken.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The shell must be born twice. Once in vacuum. Once in biology.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. Sphere Nineteen answered. The vacuum spoke.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The trehalose film held. The sugar film shattered.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The borrowed argon laser. He fixed it himself.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. First the physics. Then the living thing. Two births.

speaker: announcer
text: Petri dishes. The mold stands like timber.

speaker: announcer
text: A spill. To you, it is a lake.

speaker: announcer
text: The borrowed argon laser. A road of green light.

speaker: announcer
text: Specimen trays. Sphere Twenty-three is not itself.

speaker: announcer
text: Stand by. A photon shell. The fog is wearing the vacuum.

speaker: announcer
text: Thorne's lab has its color back. The shell is quiet. It is only listening.

speaker: announcer
text: The next bench is already forgetting its own experiment.

speaker: thorne
text: Sphere Nineteen. You grew. I can barely see you.

speaker: thorne
text: Those cultures were mine. The gray is not.

speaker: thorne
text: Fog-taken. Strike the gray. Leave the subject under it.

speaker: thorne
text: There. The gray let go.

speaker: thorne
text: Mind the spill. It is only water. It will not feel like it.

speaker: thorne
text: Argon. The green beam. Cut the fog with it.

speaker: thorne
text: Sphere Twenty-three answered once. Do not trust it now.

speaker: thorne
text: That is the shell. The fog is inside the light.

speaker: thorne
text: It is swelling. The well is getting deeper.

speaker: thorne
text: The bell jar. Pin it to the glass.

speaker: thorne
text: The fog left the shell. It is born twice.

speaker: thorne
text: I am writing this down before the color goes.

speaker: thorne
text: Sphere Nineteen. Stay intact. I cannot pick you up.

speaker: thorne
text: A page from the log. It still remembers.

speaker: thorne
text: A tray. Take what is useful.

speaker: thorne
text: The Geiger counter will remember this spot.

speaker: thorne
text: The notebook is there. We are done on this bench.
